parameters.content:
## Switch off workflows that send data to processors without a valid DPA

Every service that receives personal data from your automations is a processor, and GDPR needs a contract (a DPA) with each one. On n8n that list is whatever someone last dropped onto a canvas.

### How it works
1. Every Monday the workflow reads every workflow on this instance through the n8n API. A live workflow is judged on its published version, the one that actually runs.
2. It works out where each one sends data: service nodes, HTTP Request addresses, addresses written into Code nodes, inline and called sub-workflows, and the error workflow. Disabled nodes do not count.
3. Each processor is checked against **Processor Rules**: approved with a DPA end date, blocked, or yours.
4. A live workflow that sends data to a blocked processor, or to one whose DPA has ended, is switched off once `switch_off_blocked` is on. Until then the report names it for you to switch off. Anything nobody approved goes to review. Slack gets one report whenever something needs a person.

### Setup
1. Add an n8n API credential (Settings, n8n API) and a Slack credential, then pick the channel.
2. Fill **Processor Rules**: approved processors as `Name until YYYY-MM-DD`, blocked ones, and your own systems.
3. It ships with `switch_off_blocked` off, so the first runs only report. Read a report, then turn it on to let it act.

### Good to know
A scan with nothing to judge fails the run instead of reporting all clear, so give this workflow an error workflow that reaches a person.

## 1. Your rules
Approved processors carry the date their DPA ends. The scan runs every Monday.

## 2. Where each workflow sends data
Live workflows are judged on the version that actually runs.

## 3. Seeing nothing is not all clear
If the API returns nothing to judge, the run fails instead of reporting.

## 4. Judge each workflow
Data handed to a sub-workflow or the error workflow counts as sent.

## 5. Switch off what breaks the rules
Only live workflows, one at a time, and only when switch_off_blocked is on.

## 6. One report to Slack
A clean week stays quiet unless post_when_clean is on.
